findings.state: boss_phase_1 after left-slot placement, ink mark visible, desktop 1280x720
findings.visibleEvidence: forest-boss-lin-step07.png shows the striped ink mask spanning the central instruction and the upper portions and labels of both structure slots, while the related accessible intent says the mark briefly covers the right empty slot.
findings.whyItMatters: The left-versus-right structure is the core readable rule in this encounter. Covering the instruction and both slot cues at once weakens spatial orientation precisely when the child must understand where the second component belongs.
findings.suggestedFix: Clip the temporary ink mask to the intended right empty-slot bounds, and keep the instruction, left slot, placed component, and both position labels fully readable; preserve a non-flashing reduced-motion equivalent.

findings.state: fresh world at compact-mobile 320x568 and mobile 390x844
findings.visibleEvidence: The four labels 营地灯、墨花、守护树、星光路 are rendered as very small, dim gray text against the dark navy world in both fresh mobile screenshots; they are materially harder to read than the repaired-state yellow pills, while the ARIA snapshots confirm that the labels carry semantic text.
findings.whyItMatters: These labels identify the persistent world-repair cues. If the fresh state is barely legible, a low-vision user or a young reader cannot reliably compare what changed after the run.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise the labels to the child-facing text scale and ensure normal-text contrast meets WCAG AA; distinguish the not-yet-repaired state with readable wording, shape, or iconography rather than low opacity alone.

findings.state: battle_1_cleared, tablet 768x1024, focus on 看看光留下什么
findings.visibleEvidence: The tablet ming-formed screenshot cuts the persistent top-left game heading at the upper viewport edge, while the focused primary action is held against the lower edge. The ARIA and event evidence show that the H1 still exists and that the bottom action is the focus target.
findings.whyItMatters: A focus change should not move persistent orientation text out of or behind the viewport. The crop removes visual context for keyboard and switch users and indicates that this state does not fully respect the tablet safe viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the game shell within the dynamic viewport and reserve top and bottom safe space for the header and focused action; prevent focus scrolling from shifting the fixed scene, then re-capture with the complete H1 visible.

findings.state: catalog, compact-mobile 320x568, focus on 开始翻牌
findings.visibleEvidence: In the compact-mobile catalog screenshot, the focused first game action is visible but its contextual H2 记忆翻牌 is partially hidden beneath the fixed return-to-world bar at the top.
findings.whyItMatters: Keyboard and switch users need the focused control and its card heading visible together. A sticky navigation bar that obscures the heading weakens orientation even though the button itself remains operable.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply effective scroll padding or focus-target scroll margin for the sticky return bar so focusing a game action keeps its card heading fully below the bar; verify the 320x568 focus state again.
